questions.stem: Maximum absorption of digested food takes place in the
questions.explanation: Villi of the small intestine provide a very large absorptive surface.

questions.stem: Which group of vitamins is absorbed along with fats?
questions.explanation: These are the fat soluble vitamins.

questions.stem: The pacemaker of the human heart is the
questions.explanation: The sino atrial node initiates each heart beat.

questions.explanation: Around 70 to 75 beats per minute is normal at rest.

questions.stem: Double circulation in humans means that blood
options: Passes through the heart twice in one complete cycle
Flows in two directions in the same vessel
Is pumped only by the left ventricle

questions.stem: Fertilisation in humans normally takes place in the

questions.stem: The hormone chiefly responsible for maintaining pregnancy is
questions.explanation: Progesterone maintains the endometrium throughout pregnancy.

questions.stem: Spermatogenesis takes place in the
questions.explanation: Sperms are produced in the seminiferous tubules of the testis.

questions.stem: The average gestation period in humans is about
questions.explanation: Roughly nine months, that is about 280 days.

questions.stem: Implantation of the blastocyst occurs in the
questions.explanation: The blastocyst embeds itself in the uterine endometrium.

questions.stem: Human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) is secreted by the
questions.explanation: hCG from the placenta sustains the corpus luteum in early pregnancy.

questions.explanation: Mendel used Pisum sativum for his hybridisation experiments.

questions.stem: The law of segregation states that
options: Alleles of a gene separate during gamete formation
Genes on different chromosomes assort independently
Dominant alleles always mask recessive ones
questions.explanation: Each gamete receives only one allele of a pair.

questions.stem: The phenotypic ratio of a monohybrid cross in the F2 generation is
questions.explanation: Three dominant to one recessive phenotype.

questions.stem: Colour blindness in humans is inherited as
questions.explanation: The gene lies on the X chromosome and is recessive, so males are affected more often.

questions.stem: Down syndrome is caused by trisomy of chromosome number
questions.explanation: An extra copy of chromosome 21 causes Down syndrome.
